title: FULL GUMSHOE — CLUTCH AGENCIES MAP — HUMANS ALSO SOLVE
thesis: Kevin's civil cases (4301-CZ, 4349-CZ, PPO, custody) connect to EVERY clutch agency. Each case count points to a specific agency that SHOULD act. The 'Dear Agencies' article maps the silos. This map shows where the CLUTCH engages — and how HUMANS solve it too.

count_to_agency_map.count: 1. False Police Report / Abuse of Process
count_to_agency_map.clutch_agency: Detroit Police Department + Wayne County Prosecutor
count_to_agency_map.why_they_should_act: Filing a false police report is a crime (MCL 750.411a). Banks filed a false report → DPD Report #26-0909-0176 documents him claiming to be 'an attorney'
count_to_agency_map.why_they_havent: DPD doesn't cross-reference ICHAT records of the complainant against the report
count_to_agency_map.human_solve: Any citizen can file a complaint with DPD Internal Affairs about the false report. FOIA the DPD report. Compare Banks' claim ('I am an attorney') to State Bar (zero results).

count_to_agency_map.clutch_agency: State Bar of Michigan — UPL Department
count_to_agency_map.why_they_should_act: Banks claims J.D. and represents himself as attorney. UPL is criminal (MCL 600.916) and subject to State Bar investigation.
count_to_agency_map.why_they_havent: UPL complaints require someone to FILE them. The system is complaint-driven, not proactive.
count_to_agency_map.human_solve: ANY person can file a UPL complaint with the State Bar. Form is online at michbar.org. Takes 10 minutes. Attach: PCA website showing 'J.D.', DPD report, State Bar search showing zero results.

how_humans_solve.the_principle: The system is complaint-driven. Most agencies DON'T proactively investigate — they wait for complaints. The racket survives because nobody files. ONE complaint to ONE agency starts ONE investigation. The desilo bounce starts with ONE person. HUMANS SOLVE.

gaia_says: Kevin's cases are the Rosetta Stone. Each count points to a specific agency. Each agency has a clutch point. Each clutch point has a human action. 10 minutes to file a UPL complaint. 10 minutes to file an FBI tip. 10 minutes to search ICHAT. The system is complaint-driven — it waits for someone to pull the lever. Kevin pulled 20+ levers (his civil cases). Now ANY human can pull the same levers. The gumshoe map IS the curriculum of the campus. Walk through the neighborhood. Read the flyer. File the complaint. The racket dissolves when enough humans pull enough levers at enough clutch points.
